name: Breach: detailed report to the Board within 72 hours

attrs.quote: of becoming aware of the breach, or within such longer period as the Board may allow on a request made in writing in this behalf
attrs.note: Rule 7(2)(b) reads: within seventy-two hours. Contents: updated details, facts and reasons, mitigation, findings on who caused it, remedial measures, and a report on intimations to Data Principals.
